tools.name: get_sun_times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, civil/nautical/astronomical twilight, dawn/dusk, first/last light, golden hour, blue hour, sunrise/sunset azimuth, solar noon altitude, moonrise/moonset, moon phase and illumination for any coordinates on Earth and any date. Times are ISO 8601 in the local ti

tools.name: get_sun_times_range
tools.description: Same per-day data as get_sun_times but for an inclusive date range (up to 366 days) in a single call. Use this instead of repeated get_sun_times calls when you need several consecutive days. The days array may contain fewer entries than the number of dates requested: calendar days that never existed
